description: Search Singapore official statistics tables (Department of Statistics Singapore) by keyword. Returns resource ids and titles. The `id` of a result (e.g. "M810001") is the resourceId used by table_data and table_metadata.

searchOption.description: Where to match the keyword. "all" (default) searches everything, "title" only table titles, "variable" only variable names.

name: singstat_sg_search_tables
title: Singstat Sg Search Tables
